decks.notes: The deck focuses on using a toolbox of creatures to create a powerful combo strategy. By utilizing cards like Grist, the Hunger Tide, Yawgmoth, Thran Physician, and Eldritch Evolution, the player can quickly assemble key pieces while maintaining a board presence through creatures like Birds of Paradise and Wall of Roots. The deck aims to have a flexible game plan while being able to adapt to different situations, ultimately overwhelming the opponent with a synergistic mix of creatures and combo pieces.

This deck focuses on quickly playing aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent, while controlling the board with spells like Lightning Bolt and Counterspell. The deck also includes cards like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration to help with card advantage and deck manipulation. The goal is to disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining pressure with hasty threats. Spell pierce and Archmage's Charm provide additional control elements, with sideboard options like Dress Down for added versatility in matchups. The mana base is optimized for consistency and speed in casting spells.

This deck focuses on controlling the game by utilizing the synergy between Elementals and powerful control spells. By constantly bouncing and recurring creatures like Risen Reef and Ice-Fang Coatl with cards like Ephemerate and Teferi, Time Raveler, the deck aims to generate value and outvalue the opponent. The Elemental creatures also provide ramp and card advantage, allowing the player to stabilize and eventually overwhelm the opponent with threats like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Emrakul, the Promised End. The deck also includes a toolbox of lands and spells to deal with various threats, ensuring versatility and adaptability in different matchups.

The main focus of this UR Aggro deck is to quickly apply pressure on the opponent through efficient and versatile spells like Lightning Bolt and Counterspell, while also utilizing impactful creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent. The deck aims to control the game by disrupting the opponent's strategy and protecting its own threats, setting the pace of the game in its favor. The mana base is built to ensure consistency and flexibility in casting spells, allowing for a fast and aggressive playstyle.

The main idea of this deck is to manipulate the graveyard and cycling abilities of creatures to quickly fill the graveyard and then cast Living End to bring all of those creatures back onto the battlefield at once. The deck includes cards like Architects of Will and Street Wraith to cycle through the deck, while also featuring cards like Grief and Shardless Agent to disrupt the opponent's hand and board state. This combo-focused strategy aims to overwhelm the opponent with a sudden influx of powerful creatures while controlling the battlefield with cards like Force of Negation and Violent Outburst.

The deck focuses on cycling through cards and manipulating the graveyard in order to quickly bring back powerful creatures from the graveyard with Living End. By using cards that allow for instant speed cycling and disruptive elements like Force of Negation, the deck aims to disrupt opponents while setting up for a big Living End play to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures. The deck also includes cards like Grief and Shardless Agent to further disrupt the opponent's hand and board state, creating opportunities for a game-winning Living End combo.

This Eldrazi Aggro deck focuses on utilizing powerful Eldrazi creatures such as Matter Reshaper, Reality Smasher, and Thought-Knot Seer to quickly overwhelm opponents with aggressive plays. The deck also includes cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Chalice of the Void to disrupt opponent strategies and control the board. With a mix of creature aggression and disruption spells, this deck aims to apply early pressure and maintain board control to secure a swift victory in Modern 1 vs 1 matches.

The deck focuses on cycling creatures into the graveyard and then casting Living End to return them all to the battlefield, wiping out the opponent's board and potentially winning the game in one powerful combo. It also includes disruptive elements like Grief and Force of Negation to control the game until the combo can be executed. The deck aims to quickly generate value from cycling creatures and leveraging the powerful cascade mechanic with cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory.

The deck focuses on quickly casting Glimpse of Tomorrow to shuffle all permanents into their owners' libraries, then revealing cards from the top until each player has that same number of permanents in play. The goal is to create a powerful board state with cards like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Risen Reef while disrupting the opponent with Teferi, Time Raveler and Endurance. The deck utilizes combos with Shardless Agent and Wavesifter to generate value and overwhelming advantage on the board, aiming to win the game through explosive and unexpected plays.

This Aggro - Affinity deck focuses on quickly assembling a board presence of cheap artifacts and utilizing cards like Esper Sentinel and Ingenious Smith to generate card advantage. With powerful finishers like Urza, Lord High Artificer and Thought Monitor, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a combination of efficient creatures and disruptive spells like Teferi, Time Raveler. The inclusion of artifact lands like Darksteel Citadel and powerful saga card Urza's Saga further enhances the deck's synergies, creating a fast and formidable threat in the Modern format.

The deck revolves around assembling a toolbox of creatures to combo off and win the game efficiently. By utilizing cards like Eldritch Evolution and Chord of Calling, the deck can tutor for specific creatures to create powerful synergies and combos. Grist, the Hunger Tide is a key card in generating tokens and providing value throughout the game. Yawgmoth, Thran Physician serves as a way to sacrifice creatures and generate card advantage. The deck focuses on creature-based interactions and leveraging the toolbox of creatures to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents.

The deck focuses on utilizing efficient spells and aggressive creatures to quickly control the board and pressure the opponent. It includes a mix of countermagic, burn spells, and card draw to maintain tempo and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Mishra's Bauble and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer provide card advantage while Murktide Regent and Ledger Shredder serve as powerful threats. The mana base is designed to support the deck's aggressive strategy with a mix of fetch lands and fast lands. Dress Down can also provide utility by disabling opponent's creatures and abilities.

The deck revolves around assembling a powerful combo involving Puresteel Paladin, Colossus Hammer, and Stoneforge Mystic to equip massive threats such as Kaldra Compleat or Nettlecyst at blazing speed. Using zero-cost equipment spells, the deck aims to quickly overwhelm opponents with a deadly one-shot kill potential. Additionally, the deck includes disruptive elements like Esper Sentinel and Portable Hole to gain advantage and control the game. With efficient mana production from Inkmoth Nexus and Urza's Saga, the deck can race against opponents and win the game in a single swing.

This UR Aggro deck focuses on playing efficient threats and disrupting your opponent with countermagic and removal spells. By quickly deploying threats like Ragavan and Murktide Regent, while also holding up countermagic and removal, the deck aims to pressure the opponent while keeping their own board safe. The deck also runs card draw spells like Consider and Mishra's Bauble to find more threats and answers. The mana base is designed to consistently provide the colors necessary for the spells in the deck.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly put pressure on the opponent with aggressive creatures like Dragon's Rage Channeler, Murktide Regent, and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, while disrupting their game plan with counterspells and removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat. Draw power is provided by cards like Expressive Iteration and Mishra's Bauble, enabling the player to maintain momentum. The mana base is designed to support the aggressive nature of the deck while providing enough flexibility for playing spells with diverse color requirements.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through enchantments, utilizing cards like Destiny Spinner, Sanctum Weaver, and Enchantress's Presence to ramp up mana and draw additional cards. It also includes cards like Blood Moon and Solitary Confinement to disrupt opponents and protect itself. The deck aims to create a lock on the board with cards like Sphere of Safety while using Sterling Grove to search for key enchantments. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue opponents with its enchantress engine and establish a dominating board presence.
